Naturally refreshing and bursting with the beloved flavour of 'Nariyal Paani', this pure, fat-free beverage offers a tropical paradise experience anytime, anywhere. Crafted with no added sugar or artificial flavours, it's the perfect choice to keep you hydrated throughout the day. Enjoy the smooth, creamy texture and the naturally sweet taste that will transport you to a serene coconut grove. Whether you're on the go or relaxing at home, B Natural Select Tender Coconut Water is your go-to drink for a truly refreshing and satisfying experience.
details.ingredients: Water (90.5%), concentrated tender coconut water (9.5%), minerals, preservatives (INS 202, INS 224, INS 234), natural flavours and natural flavouring substances.

details.description: B Natural Coconut Cola is a refreshing sparkling beverage that combines the distinctive taste of cola with the light, tropical notes of tender coconut water. Crafted for a unique flavour experience, it offers a balanced blend of fizz and refreshment in every sip. Best enjoyed chilled, it is a delightful choice for social gatherings, meals or moments of indulgence.
details.ingredients:
Reconstituted Tender Coconut Water (54%) [Water, Concentrated Tender Coconut Water (4.1%), Preservative (INS 202(ii))], Water, Carbonating Agent (Carbon Dioxide), Natural Flavours and Natural Flavouring Substances, Colour (INS 150a), Acidity Regulators (INS 330, INS 331(iii)), Nature-Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Sweetener (INS 960) and Preservative (INS 211).
